audit_type: Security & Integration Verification of Workspace Isolation and Provenance

test_matrix.name: Acme excludes Globex evidence
test_matrix.description: SEC-G001 excluded from all stages when querying ws_acme_corp

test_matrix.name: Cross-workspace negative test
test_matrix.description: Identical query yields workspace-isolated result sets

test_matrix.name: Hybrid retrieval isolation
test_matrix.description: Top-5 candidates belong 100% to requested workspace

test_matrix.name: RRF isolation
test_matrix.description: Inputs entering RRF fusion are pre-filtered by workspace

test_matrix.name: Reranker isolation
test_matrix.description: Cross-Encoder candidate lists strictly scoped pre- and post-rerank

test_matrix.name: SLM evidence isolation
test_matrix.description: Evidence passed to SLM contains only target workspace chunks

test_matrix.name: Provenance preservation
test_matrix.description: chunk_id, workspace_id, document_id, title, version, excerpt survive intact

test_matrix.name: Version preservation
test_matrix.description: Version metadata (e.g. 2026-01) attached and unaltered through pipeline

test_matrix.name: Chunk identity stability
test_matrix.description: chunk_id values remain stable from index to review payload

test_matrix.name: Workspace field persistence
test_matrix.description: workspace_id field present across all intermediate dictionaries

test_matrix.name: Wrong workspace negative test
test_matrix.description: Foreign candidate explicitly rejected if injected into filtering

test_matrix.name: Missing/unknown workspace behavior
test_matrix.description: Empty or unknown workspace produces zero evidence / safe abstention

test_matrix.name: Workspace filter bypass attempt
test_matrix.description: Semantic similarity of foreign workspace document cannot override filter

test_matrix.name: Review UI/API provenance
test_matrix.description: Review endpoint payload contains complete provenance metadata

invariants_verified: INVARIANT 1: Every final evidence result belongs to requested workspace.
INVARIANT 2: Every SLM evidence chunk belongs to requested workspace.
INVARIANT 3: Workspace filtering occurs BEFORE RRF.
INVARIANT 4: Cross-Encoder reranking cannot introduce a new workspace.
INVARIANT 5: Provenance metadata survives retrieval and reranking.
INVARIANT 6: Version metadata remains attached to source document/chunk.
INVARIANT 7: Missing/invalid workspace context does not cause global retrieval.
INVARIANT 8: Filtering enforced at retrieval layer, not UI-only.
